items.label: Tượng Dobby cưỡi thú nhún
items.subject: A garden STATUE of Dobby the house-elf (tiny, huge bat-like ears, big round green eyes, long pointy nose, thin limbs, wearing only an old pillowcase tied like a toga, one mismatched sock) happily riding a playground spring-rider toy shaped like a little blue hippogriff: the toy sits on a thick coiled metal spring that is bolted to a low square stone plinth. Dobby grins, one hand raised waving, ears flapping. Cheerful, cute, celebratory. Whole statue including plinth fully visible, the plinth is the ground contact.

items.label: Tượng Dobby Hắc Ám
items.subject: A garden STATUE of a sinister "Dark Dobby" house-elf carved from deep RED stone (crimson body, dark plum shadows): huge bat-like ears swept back, narrowed glowing amber eyes, sly toothy grin, pillowcase toga with ragged hem, one hand raising a single sock like a trophy, the other hand on hip. Stands on a low square dark stone plinth with a few cracks and small red rune marks. Mischievous-menacing, not gory. Whole statue including plinth fully visible, the plinth is the ground contact.
items.motionNote: Localized glow is limited to a connected bright component above the grounded quarter.

items.label: Lều gia tinh
items.subject: A small cosy house-elf TENT in a wizard garden, sewn from old patched pillowcases and faded tea towels in cream, rust and plum, a little round flap door held open with a wooden peg showing a warm lamp-lit inside with a tiny straw bed, a string of drying mismatched woolly socks as bunting across the front, a knitted woolly hat on the tent pole tip, a tiny lantern hanging by the door, two little pairs of elf shoes outside. Low and wide, the tent base is the ground contact on a 2x2 tile footprint. Cute, humble, homely.
items.motionNote: Localized glow is limited to a connected bright component above the grounded quarter.

items.label: Góc bếp
items.subject: A house-elf KITCHEN CORNER like the Hogwarts kitchens, set outdoors: a small low brick hearth with a glowing fire under a big copper pot steaming with stew, beside it a low wooden work table with a stack of plates, a golden pie and a brown teapot, a ladle and copper pans hanging from a short wooden rail above. Everything elf-sized, warm and busy. The hearth and table stand side by side along a 2x1 tile footprint (long axis along the strip). Bases are the ground contact.

items.label: Cây chổi Tia Chớp quà Giáng sinh
items.subject: A Christmas present just opened in a wizard garden: a sleek racing BROOMSTICK with a polished dark mahogany handle and a neat streamlined tail of pale golden birch twigs, standing upright in a small wooden display stand, a gold registration number glinting near the top of the handle. At its foot lies its long torn-open parcel: crumpled red wrapping paper, a loose gold ribbon bow and an unsigned gift tag. Elegant, fast-looking, precious. The stand and parcel are the ground contact on a 1x1 tile.
items.motionNote: Localized glow is limited to a connected bright component above the grounded quarter.

items.label: Quầy bia bơ quán Ba Cây Chổi
items.subject: A snowy outdoor BUTTERBEER COUNTER from a cosy old village inn: a short low wooden bar counter with a snow-dusted top, three big foaming tankards of hot golden butterbeer with creamy froth on it, a small copper barrel keg with a tap at one end, a holly garland along the front and a little warm lantern on a post. Warm, inviting, steaming. The counter runs along the length of a 2x1 tile strip (in the turned view along the other axis). Its base is the ground contact.
items.motionNote: Localized glow is limited to a connected bright component above the grounded quarter.

items.label: Tủ kẹo tiệm Công tước Mật
items.subject: A wizard SWEETSHOP CABINET set outdoors in winter: a wide old wooden shop shelf-cabinet with a small striped awning on top dusted with snow, its shelves crowded with big glass jars of bright sweets, rows of chocolate frog boxes, a bundle of sugar quills, round bonbons and colourful candy sticks; a little hanging sign with a candy shape (no letters). Cheerful, crowded with colour, a child's dream. The cabinet stands along the length of a 2x1 tile strip (in the turned view along the other axis). Its base is the ground contact.
items.motionNote: Localized glow is limited to a connected bright component above the grounded quarter.

items.label: Áo khoác tàng hình trong gói quà
items.subject: A small square Christmas PARCEL in plain brown paper, lid lifted, with a silvery-grey shimmering fluid magic cloak spilling out and over its side like water; where the cloak folds over the edge part of it fades into nothing, so the ground and parcel behind it show through (a real invisibility effect drawn with hard pixels: the cloak ends abruptly in transparent gaps). A folded note lies on top. Mysterious, quiet, precious. The parcel is the ground contact on a 1x1 tile.

items.label: Cây thông Giáng sinh nhà Weasley
items.subject: A big homely family CHRISTMAS TREE in a wizard garden: a full fir tree in a wooden tub, decorated with golden fairy lights, red and gold baubles and paper chains, a few wrapped presents around the tub. On the very top, instead of an angel, sits a grumpy little bald potato-headed GARDEN GNOME with knobbly feet, dressed in a tutu with small wings glued to its back, scowling. Cosy, a bit chaotic, funny. The tub and presents are the ground contact on a 2x2 tile.
items.motionNote: Localized glow is limited to a connected bright component above the grounded quarter.

items.label: Vườn hồng đêm Dạ vũ
items.subject: A magical Yule Ball ROSE GARDEN on a winter night: a low curving arch of dark rose bushes with deep red roses and tiny glowing fairies sitting among the flowers like living lights, a small carved pale-stone STATUE of Father Christmas beside a stone sleigh pulled by two stone reindeer, a light dusting of snow on the leaves and statues. Romantic, enchanted, glittering. Spread along the length of a 3x2 tile footprint (in the turned view along the other axis); bushes and statue bases are the ground contact.
items.motionNote: Localized glow is limited to a connected bright component above the grounded quarter.

items.label: Cây thông nhà vô địch
items.subject: The CHAMPION HOUSE CHRISTMAS TREE of a Hogwarts Yule Ball, standing in a wizard garden: a tall slender fir tree like the twelve great trees of the Great Hall, glittering with many small golden stars, a few lit floating candles hovering beside it, silver tinsel garlands, a big bright gold star on top, a small gold cup-shaped trophy and a wrapped present at its foot, set in a squat stone planter with a thin rim of snow. Majestic, festive, proud. The stone planter is the ground contact on a 2x2 tile.
